description: This file is responsible for generating and sending a PDF version of an invoice via email, including setting up the controller, loading the record, determining the filename, and outputting the PDF for download.

classes.name: Vtiger_InvoicePDFController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling invoice PDF generation and output.

methods.name: loadRecord
methods.description: Loads the invoice record data based on the record ID.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF file, either for download or other purposes.
